AddEntry(Entry, bool)

Adds a new entry to this reorderable enum setting.

public void AddEntry(OnixSettingReorderableEnum.Entry entry, bool ignoreOrderIndex = false)

Parameters

entry OnixSettingReorderableEnum.Entry

The entry to add.

ignoreOrderIndex bool

When true, the entry's OrderIndex and DefaultOrderIndex are set to the end of the list instead of using the values provided on creation.

Remarks

You must never use the entry again after adding it; ownership is transferred to the setting.

SetEntries(IEnumerable<Entry>, bool)

Sets the new list of entries. You should never use any of those entries again, don't use the list it came from. You should use the helper functions whenever possible instead of dealing with raw entries like that.

public void SetEntries(IEnumerable<OnixSettingReorderableEnum.Entry> entries, bool orderFromEnumerableIndex)

Parameters

entries IEnumerable<OnixSettingReorderableEnum.Entry>

The entries to set.

orderFromEnumerableIndex bool

Whether the OrderIndex gets set from the enumerable's index or stays untouched. (You need to make sure it's valid before you send it in if you don't.)
